description: Process A opens the fixture shared read/write through Workspaces(0), opened a table-type recordset, called AddNew and set fields, without Update, signals and is terminated by TerminateProcess without any release or Close. After 1.5 s, process B keeps the database and lock-file bytes (frozen before any opener) and reads the lock file natively; then process B compacts a frozen copy with DBEngine.CompactDatabase to a new file, then opens and reads the compacted output. Process-termination model only (live OS cache).
retentionNote: Designed r-crash-1-kill probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
